integrity.claim_scope: finite-amplitude stationary identities for the displayed normalized ODE
integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; a supplementary exact-arithmetic checker verifies algebraic specializations

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to compactly supported invariant probability measures supported strictly inside the positive quadrant.
It does not prove existence, uniqueness, or global attraction of a periodic orbit.
The generic Holling-II ingredient in the first identity may have classical analogues; the source-specific paired identity is the originality target.
title: Exact stationary mean-shift and variance shell for a strong-Allee Holling-II predator–prey flow
